reviews.title: Build & Quality will last
reviews.comment:
I had the XL older version, Have had it for many years, and still to this day.
Tracking with the mouse is great, material has held up well.  Which is why I've finally decided to upgrade to the wider version.  However this one is much much thinner then my old version.  So only time will tell how well it will hold up.
Gliding speed is very good and smooth, and the size is fantastic.
reviews.author: BULLBOYKENNELS

reviews.title: QCK XXL
reviews.comment: The size was perfect. Super easy to clean off with a micro fiber cloth. Bought this thinking it was the QCK heavy and was a little throw off by the speed. Nevertheless still a great mousepad if you’re looking for speed>control. Not what I was looking for so I returned and purchased a QCK heavy.
